note: The help center answers automated requests with 403; the list was read from the Internet Archive snapshot of the same page (web.archive.org/web/2025/) on the check date.

quit.from: macOS convention; the cited page does not list it

goBack.from: Go back on tab history (Command-Left Arrow or Command-Left Bracket)

goForward.from: Go forward on tab history (Command-Right Arrow or Command-Right Bracket)

previousSpace.from: Switch between Spaces (Command-Option-Left Arrow or Option-Command-Right Arrow)

nextSpace.from: Switch between Spaces (Command-Option-Left Arrow or Option-Command-Right Arrow)

notFound.showSidebar: The page lists one Show/Hide the Sidebar command (Command-S), which Compact Mode takes; it lists no separate command to reveal a hidden sidebar over the page.
notFound.closeWindow: The page lists only Command-W, which closes the current tab or window.
notFound.focusTabList: The page lists no command to move the focus to the sidebar.
notFound.moveTabUp: The page lists no command to move a tab; Command-Option-Up Arrow switches tabs instead.
notFound.moveTabDown: The page lists no command to move a tab; Option-Command-Down Arrow switches tabs instead.
